info.name: Spiritwolf API
info.description: Backend API requests. Register and verify the emailed code before password login. Onboarding GET, create, and edit requests require the signed-in user's session. The frontend collects all onboarding fields and submits them together once. Password login does not create accounts. Use the saved Bearer token or session cookie for protected requests.

request.description: Starts registration and emails a 6-digit code; it does not create an account/session yet. Expected: 202 with a message and email. Configure SMTP on the backend, and change testEmail if already registered.
Read the code from the email, update verificationCode, and send within 5 minutes. Successful response is 201 with user and token; the collection saves the token for subsequent calls.
Resends a code for a pending registration. Wait at least one minute between requests.

Only works after Register and Verify email have successfully created the account. Login never creates an account. Expected: 200 with a user, token, and session cookie; the collection saves the token. Unregistered or unverified users receive 401.
Requires the Bearer token saved after email verification or login. Expected: 200 {"user":{"id":"...","name":"...","email":"..."}}.
No body. Clears the session cookie. Expected: 200 {"message":"Logged out."}.
Browser-based OAuth flow; configure Google credentials and start this endpoint in a browser. It redirects to Google. The Google callback is handled at /api/auth/google/callback.
Google supplies these query parameters and the matching state cookie during the browser sign-in flow. Do not send placeholder values; this request is listed for endpoint reference only.

item.name: Onboarding
item.description: All requests require login and are scoped to the signed-in user. The frontend collects answers across its four UI steps and sends one full onboarding object at the end; use Edit onboarding to replace an existing profile.

request.description: Requires a session. Returns the saved flat onboarding object, completion status, and completion time. A new account receives 200 {"onboarding":null,"completed":false,"completedAt":null}.

request.description: Create a profile once after the user completes all four frontend UI screens. The body uses one flat onboarding object with all answers, not numbered steps. Validation failure returns 400 and saves nothing. If a profile already exists, returns 409; use Edit onboarding. Success returns the flat onboarding profile, completed=true, and next="analysis".

request.description: Replace all onboarding fields for the signed-in user. Send the full flat object (same shape as Submit onboarding), not a partial step update. Returns 404 if the user has not created a profile yet.

Requires a session, completed onboarding, and a configured backend AI_API_KEY. The saved onboarding profile is automatically included in the analysis context. If onboarding is incomplete, returns 409. Expected: 201 {"analysis":{"id":"...","decision":"...","report":{"executiveSummary":"...","recommendation":"...","confidence":"low|medium|high","keyConsiderations":["..."],"nextSteps":["..."],"assumptions":["..."],"risks":["..."]},"createdAt":"..."}}.
Requires a session. No body. Expected: 200 {"analyses":[...]} with up to 50 latest reports.

Requires a session. Select a local .txt, .csv, .md, .pdf, or .xlsx file for the file form field. Do not set Content-Type manually; Postman adds the multipart boundary. Expected: 200 {"fileName":"notes.txt","text":"...","characters":123}.
